items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 14 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Fort Yukon, Beaver, Stevens Village, Rampart, and Tanana.

High water due to snowmelt continues to make its way down the
Porcupine and Yukon Rivers, which will eventually encounter the
breakup front which is nearing Nulato. High water may result in
flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying and
flood-prone locations.
items.areas: Dalton Highway Summits; Yukon Flats; Central Interior

items.description:
